notes.title: Steam cards and bug fixes
notes.notes:
We have just published an update for A Normal Lost Phone!

In addition to fixing some minor - but annoying - typos, this update fixes a bug that prevented players to request a new Be You password after receiving one by e-mail once. Players who had experienced this bug prior to the update need to restart the game by going to the game’s Settings app and picking “Erase all data”.

We took this as an opportunity to add Steam cards for the game, as well as the associated badges, emoticons and backgrounds. You can start collecting them right now!
